TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: lore
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: Knowledge of the old kingdom: its history, its rites, its ruins, and the things written on barrow walls.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: thievery
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: Locks, traps, sleight of hand, and the professional appraisal of other people's property.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: nature
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: Wayfinding, foraging, weather-sense, and knowing which things in the woods bite.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: athletics
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: Climbing, swimming, forcing doors, and holding a shield wall past the point of good sense.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: persuasion
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: Bargaining, flattery, intimidation, and the gentle art of getting your way with words.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: arcana
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: The theory behind the old magic: sigils, seals, wards, and what the archotech dreamers left humming under the hills.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: investigation
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: Reading a room, a ruin, or a crime: tracks, tampered locks, false walls, and stories that don't add up.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: insight
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: Reading people: what they want, what they fear, and which of the two is talking.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: perception
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: Noticing things: the glint in the murder-hole, the fresh scrape on old stone, the silence where birdsong should be.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: survival
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: Staying alive between towns: shelter, fire, clean water, and knowing when the weather means to kill you.

TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.label: performance
TheShatteredCrown.TSC_ProficiencyDef.description: Song, story, and spectacle: holding a room, a camp, or a mob in the palm of your hand.
